verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The Government of India has not announced a 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026'. Messages promoting this are a scam designed to steal personal information. While some state governments have their own laptop schemes, no such national program exists.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple TIER_1 and TIER_2 sources, including the government's Press Information Bureau (PIB), have explicitly stated that the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' does not exist and that messages about it are part of a scam to collect personal data. While one source mentions that some state-level laptop schemes are real, all evidence confirms there is no such central government scheme.
